d:
What really happens behind the scenes on a Formula 1 race weekend?
Mercedes Trackside Engineering Director Andrew Shovlin takes us inside the world of F1 engineering, from the decisions made on the pit wall and the use of secret strategy codes to how teams interpret driver radio messages.
He also explains how AI helps transcribe team radio, what drivers mean when they say their tyres are gone, the cost of repairing a damaged F1 car, and why Kimi Antonelli's memory for lap times continues to impress.
